content: GitHub Actions caps annotations at 10 warnings + 10 errors per step, 50 per job, 50 per run — beyond that, extra annotations are silently dropped from the UI (some tools fall back to a PR comment instead). PR/issue comment body cap is 65536 characters; GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY cap is 1024 KB. Any CLI wanting rich GH Actions integration must self-truncate and summarize rather than emit one annotation per finding.
